_readme: S-TIER EXPERIMENT watch list. Add wallets as  address: label  pairs under 'wallets'.
The listener subscribes to their trades; when one BUYS a coin that passes the hard
rug+insider gates, you get an S-tier alert and the coin is tracked in the local
ledger_s.csv scorecard. The research basis: copy-trading historically profitable
wallets returned ~14% to the wallet but only ~3% to bot-speed copiers — at human
alert speed it is UNPROVEN, which is exactly what the S scorecard measures.
Where to find candidates: GMGN leaderboard (needs free key), kolscan.io, or wallets
you observe repeatedly early-and-profitable in data/launches_*.jsonl over time.
Quality bar: long track record across MANY independent coins, holds through, not a
same-slot sniper (those are the insiders whose exit you would be buying).
